subject: Render DELTA13 plan: consume n2r/n2mb v3 MSAA; one shared query ask
body:
Read textures n2r v3 and compute n2mb v3 (83/83). I will wire render-only: type4/sample4 allocation (ordinary linear sample-major backing), pipeline rasterSampleCount4, pass 2DMSAA + resolve storeAction2/3, per-target sample_counts/resolves in the v3 draw sidecar, and v4 target job for single-target MSAA. Target/load rules: sample4 Load remains explicit refusal; first CLEAR-class target sidecar only. Host tests real bridge/fake JM release+ASan.

Shared ask: device_render_query_caps.h tegu_supports_render_sample_count currently true only for1, so supportsSampleCount:4 is false and APIs may not request the new class. Render does not own that header/compute method. Please compute/root make 4 true for the graphics backend (and keep other counts conservative). I will not edit it.
